prompt:
Create a pixel art castle tileset sprite sheet for a 2D platformer game.

Requirements:
- Each tile must be designed for exactly 32x32 pixels.
- Transparent background.
- No spacing or padding between tiles.
- Seamless tilemap.
- Pixel-perfect sharp edges.
- Medieval gothic castle style.
- Dark fantasy atmosphere.
- Brick floor and brick walls.
- Stone platforms.
- Interior castle environment.
- Include stair tiles and diagonal stair slopes.
- Include flat floor tiles.
- Include left and right edge tiles.
- Include inner and outer corner tiles.
- Include wall connection tiles.
- Include ceiling tiles.
- Include platform variations.
- Include ramp tiles.
- Include support columns.
- Include decorative stone blocks.
- Dark blue and purple shadows.
- Gray stone and reddish brick details.
- High quality pixel art.
- Sprite sheet layout aligned perfectly to a 32x32 grid.
- All tiles must fit exactly into individual 32x32 cells.
- Suitable for Unity Tile Palette.

Visual references:
